title: Document counts through an order aggregation
method: Synthetic fixture has 1,000 orders,100 qualifying orders, exactly 4 line items per qualifying order, and 20 distinct product identifiers. Stage counts are 1,000→100→400→20. This illustrates cardinality, not latency or resource consumption.
alt: Document counts through an order aggregation. Source orders: 1000 documents; Matched orders: 100 documents; Unwound items: 400 documents; Product groups: 20 documents. Illustrative values.
